outputs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: original painted fantasy tactical battle animation supplement. SIX complete articulated figures in 3 columns x 2 rows, clear generous gutters and margins around every weapon and foot. Same three-quarter camera facing screen RIGHT, identical body and equipment scale throughout. Genuine transparent background, no drawn checkerboard, no text, no numbers, no ground shadows, no scenery. No new equipment or added limbs. Preserve original paint style and identity.
Input1 exact fixed identity reference: tall biped Foundry Saint with black/brass/ivory armor, spiked orange circular halo, cathedral furnace chest, ivory knees/long seal-marked cloth and hanging banners. EXACTLY two arms: anatomical RIGHT arm at viewer LEFT holds long forge tongs gripping ONE orange rectangular ingot; LEFT arm at viewer RIGHT holds one forge hammer. Keep hammer handle same fixed elbow-to-hand length as reference, NOT a long staff; do not switch hands. Top-left all-planted travel stance, hammer upright close to left shoulder, tongs held clear of thighs. Top-middle near RIGHT boot lifts at hip/knee, sole fully clear, far LEFT boot alone supports torso; keep one knee per leg. Top-right far LEFT boot lifts forward at hip/knee, near RIGHT boot alone supports torso. Keep torso facing fixed; this is a deliberate one-foot-at-a-time mechanical creep, not running. Bottom-left second guard with LEFT hammer held across upper chest, RIGHT tongs low clear of legs still gripping ingot, both boots grounded. Bottom-middle dying kneel with right knee down, head bows and furnace/halo fading; retain normal-length hammer in LEFT hand resting beside knee, NOT stretched into a walking stick, RIGHT tongs still retain dimming ingot. Bottom-right intermediate fall toward its RIGHT side/viewer-left, hips already near ground and torso diagonal, one bent knee and one stretched leg, halo tilts with head; hammer/tongs lower with their correct hands, cooled ingot still retained, furnace nearly dark. It is not yet fully prone. Keep all tool shafts and body inside their cells.

unselected_cells.2: Repeats far-leg lift; replaced by guide-led near-leg pose.
unselected_cells.5: Head-right fall opposes head-left corpse; replaced by corpse-led collapse.

Full single figure with generous margins, matching same painted style/camera, genuine transparent background, no scenery/floor/shadow/text. Do not add flames or smoke.

preparation: Owner-approved deterministic background and narrow-edge extraction only. No local pose painting, mirroring, warping or equipment synthesis. Guides/composites are authoring references, not runtime art.
